description.value: Wally's Burgers is a family-operated BC institution with over 65 years of history, now running seasonally out of Cates Park in North Vancouver. The menu features classic smash burgers, loaded hot dogs, fish and chips, poutine, and old-school milkshakes, all made with fresh local ingredients and their signature Wally's Sauce. Cates Park is a well-known cycling destination on the North Shore waterfront, making this a natural and well-loved pit stop for riders on that route.
